description.value: Foody World is a large-format Chinese supermarket spanning approximately 60,000 sq ft with ten departments and over 40,000 product varieties, making it one of the more comprehensive grocery stops in the Richmond area. Part of a chain founded in 2001 and headquartered in Toronto, this Richmond location offers a wide selection of Asian and general grocery products in a spacious shopping environment. A touring cyclist needing to restock with a broad range of fresh foods, produce, and pantry items will find it a well-stocked one-stop option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms the store is open 365 days (Monday–Sunday), directly contradicting the OSM tag 'opening_hours=closed', which appears stale or erroneous. The website corroborates the discovered URL, provides a full address and phone number, and describes a large (~60,000 sq ft) Chinese supermarket with 40,000+ product varieties, confirming basic groceries. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM tag 'opening_hours=closed' contradicts the website, which clearly states the store is open Monday–Sunday and 365 days a year. The OSM tag appears stale and should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational large supermarket at a confirmed physical address with an active website; highly useful to touring cyclists for grocery resupply.
